:::{#exm-sufficient-condition}
#### A sufficient condition

For a real number $x$, "if $x > 5$, then $x > 2$" is true,
because a number greater than $5$ is greater than $2$.
So $x > 5$ is a sufficient condition for $x > 2$:
knowing that $x = 6$ satisfies $x > 5$ is enough to conclude that $6 > 2$.

:::
